name: writing-ai-governance-policies
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to write, review or update their company's AI governance policy: a short set of rules every AI workflow, skill and agent must meet, each with a named check. Triggers: "write our AI governance policy", "write our AI policy", "review our AI governance policy", "update the AI policy after an incident", "what rules should our AI workflows follow". On a first run it reads the user's AI Registry and any governance records, asks a few questions about how the company uses AI, and drafts rules built on the eight governance practices, each with a check. On later runs it finds what changed since the last review, checks that every check still works, and proposes changes rule by rule. It never changes the policy without the user's approval. Not for writing one workflow's governance record, staff rules for using AI tools, setting up the registry (scaffolding-registry), writing an SOP (writing-workflow-sops), or auditing skills for drift (auditing-agent-skills).
